content: Hi all! Lean will be presenting at the Microsoft Research Summit tomorrow! @Leonardo de Moura @Jeremy Avigad and @Heather Macbeth will be speaking in our session called "Empowering mathematicians with technology", sharing how Lean is changing the mathematical community. It's going to be a great talk - they did a terrific job! Register to view here.
Will this be recorded? I'll be teaching at that time.
Are the three sessions with the same title repeats, or continuations, of each other?
Presumably continuations, with Leo/Jeremy/Heather speaking in some order.

I’m not so sure. When I signed up, it asked which session I’m attending: America, Europe/Africa, Pacific. I think this means the talks are recorded, all fit within an hour total, and are repeated for each time zone. But this is speculation.

Jason Rute said:

I’m not so sure. When I signed up, it asked which session I’m attending: America, Europe/Africa, Pacific. I think this means the talks are recorded, all fit within an hour total, and are repeated for each time zone. But this is speculation.

Yes, I think you're right! I've just watched all three of the talks.
Thanks Leo, Jeremy, and Heather for the inspiring talks. I'm hesitant to dream quite as big as Jeremy, but it's nice that someone does. :-)
The sessions are all the same just different time zones. If there’s a recording (I’d be surprised if there wasn’t!) I’ll post it here too :)
And there's also a recording of the "Correct computational law and civil procedure with the Lean Proof Assistant" talk at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TuWRj_SZIUo
Thanks @Mauricio Collares ! I came here just now to post this :smile:
